correctness.rationale: For every m, each binary valuation reduces via a surjective bounded morphism to a support model H_S on at most 24 points. Every support of size <=m arises from an m-column valuation. For all 255 nonempty supports, a depth-type recursion on precisely 3072 states computes the complete partition; a characteristic-formula induction proves that each distinct type is separated by a formula. The checker exhaustively verifies the full partition, confirms no merge of old types, and proves stability after depth 4 by identical depth-4 and depth-5 partitions. An independent direct labelled-valuation implementation verifies all 8+64+512+4096+32768 valuations for m=1..5. This combination proves the infinite parameter statement and sharp depth/width boundaries; neither sampled tests nor infinite extrapolation are used.

originality.rationale: The exact stable 164-type count, sharp five-column threshold and depth-four cutoff are not implied by the inspected qualitative local-tabularity, finite axiomatizability or bounded-morphism results. The 2003 paper analyzes arbitrary S5-squared frames and uses matrices of cluster intersection sizes, but does not count one-letter pointed equivalence types on the class of complete 3-by-m grids. The 2026 paper establishes product and semiproduct FMP and qualitative local tabularity in a different class. The closest accessible published proper-cover record addresses minimal world blow-up, not the formula quotient. The previously recorded two-layer S4-times-S5 theorem concerns a different first-factor frame and at most two levels; it supplies no classification of the three-row S5 family. Residual unindexed-literature priority risk remains.

value.rationale: The class of three-row S5 products is a natural fixed-factor subclass of the standard two-dimensional equivalence products. Local tabularity and finite model properties motivate an exact one-variable quotient. The result determines the entire unary formula algebra over an infinite family of finite products, establishes a sharp column cutoff strictly below the eight possible triple colors, and identifies the optimal modal depth four. This is a complete classification and an expressive boundary rather than an arbitrary finite test or an unmotivated numerical curiosity.
